title: Lil Woof reacts: how did they survive
hook: How did he survive this landing?

beats.line: Okay, the game said land near the dock. Simple. My man is coming in sideways like the plane owes him money.
Nah. Nah nah nah. That plane just did a full barrel roll into the ocean and parked itself. I have seen dogs fall off a couch worse than that.
Everybody on that flight needs to call their mama right now. Then call a lawyer.
Two billion dollars of physics, and the plane said, you know what, I am a boat now. Do not question it. Just accept it.
